subject: Forgot my password
body: Hi, forgot my password again over the weekend and now I'm locked out after a couple of tries. Can you reset it? Thanks.

subject: VPN won't connect from home
body: The VPN client keeps failing to connect from home this morning, error says 'authentication failed'. I've restarted the laptop and the app. Office network is fine.

subject: Laptop won't turn on
body: My laptop is completely dead, no lights at all even when plugged into the charger. It's the Dell Latitude I got last year. Tried a different socket, nothing.

subject: Outlook not syncing
body: Outlook stopped pulling new mail around 8am, nothing new in my inbox since then. Webmail in the browser works fine and shows the missing emails.

subject: Access to Finance shared drive
body: Could you please grant me access to the Finance shared drive? I need it for month-end close. My manager is Anil Rao if you need sign-off.

subject: Suspicious email - reporting
body: Forwarding an email I got that's asking me to verify my login details through a link. Looks like a scam. I have NOT clicked anything. Can you confirm?

subject: Setting up Authenticator
body: How do I set up the Microsoft Authenticator app for MFA on my new phone? Is there a guide? Thanks in advance.

subject: New starter Monday
body: New hire Jason Mbeki starts this Monday. He'll need a laptop, an email account, and Teams access set up before he arrives. He reports to me.

subject: Lost phone with authenticator
body: I lost my phone which had the authenticator app on it, so I can't get past MFA to log in. I think I need my MFA reset so I can re-enroll on my replacement phone.

subject: Monitor flickering
body: My external monitor keeps flickering and going black every few minutes then coming back. I've reseated the cable and swapped the port, no change.

subject: Installing Zoom
body: What's the process to get Zoom installed on my work laptop? I don't have admin rights so I can't do it myself.

subject: Conference room wifi down
body: The wifi in the 4th floor conference room is down - the whole team is here for a meeting and none of us can connect. Everywhere else seems fine.

subject: Can't send emails from home
body: When I work from home my emails just sit in the outbox and won't send. It's fine when I'm in the office. I'm on my usual laptop. Not sure what's going on.
note: Symptom is email, but root cause could be VPN or connectivity - plausibly vpn_network or email_issue.

subject: Computer acting weird
body: Hey, my computer's been acting really weird the last few days. Can someone take a look when you get a chance? Thanks.
note: No concrete symptom given - genuinely underspecified, should read as low confidence.

subject: Slow laptop and folder access
body: Two things really - my laptop has been painfully slow all week, AND I can't open the finance shared folder anymore, it says access denied. Both are driving me up the wall.
note: Two distinct issues in one email (hardware + access_request) - forces the model to pick one.

subject: Can't get into the CRM
body: How do I get into the CRM? I go to the login page and it just won't let me in. Not sure if I'm doing something wrong or if I don't have an account.
note: Unclear whether they lack access (access_request) or lack knowledge (howto_question).

subject: Getting loads of weird emails
body: I've been getting tons of weird emails the last few days, like 20 a day from names I don't recognise. Is something wrong with my account?
note: Could be ordinary spam (email_issue) or a phishing/compromise signal (security_concern).

subject: Everything is slow
body: The internet is super slow on my machine today, pages take forever to load. Not sure if it's just me, the office network, or something else.
note: Could be network (vpn_network), a hardware issue on the machine, or an external ISP problem.

subject: Not authorized in payroll app
body: I can log into my computer completely fine, but when I open the payroll app it says 'not authorized'. What gives? I had it last month.
note: Phrased around logging in, but it's actually an app permission issue - risks being read as password_reset.

subject: URGENT need help
body: URGENT!! Nothing is working and I have a deadline in an hour. Please someone call me right away.
note: High urgency, zero diagnostic detail - impossible to categorize confidently.

subject: Contractor joining design project
body: We've got a contractor, Dana Feld, joining the design project for the next 3 months. She'll need access to the Figma files and the brand assets drive to get started.
note: Sits between onboarding (new person setup) and access_request (specific resources).

subject: Printer jammed again
body: The printer on the 3rd floor is jammed again, third time this week. Can someone come and sort it out? It's holding everyone up.
note: Could be hardware (device fault) or a facilities/other matter depending on how IT scopes printers.

subject: Out of office reply
body: How do I set an out-of-office auto-reply on my email? I'm going on leave from Friday and want it on before I go.
note: A how-to, but tightly coupled to email - could be misread as email_issue.

subject: Did I get hacked?
body: A colleague told me they got a strange message 'from me' that I definitely never sent. Did my account get hacked, or is it just spam using my name?
note: Possible account compromise (security_concern) vs spoofing/spam - vague evidence.

subject: Clicked something I shouldn't have
body: I think I messed up. I clicked a link in an email and now there's a new toolbar in my browser that I definitely didn't install. Is that bad? What should I do?
note: High-stakes compromise, but surface symptoms (browser toolbar) could be misread as hardware or howto.

subject: Disable Sarah's access
body: Sarah Cole left the company last Friday. Please disable her email and system access when you get a chance - want to make sure everything's tidied up.
note: Offboarding with a security dimension (deprovisioning) - must route to a human.

subject: admin on billing
body: quick one - can you just make me an admin on the billing system so I can sort invoices myself? saves going back and forth. cheers
note: Casual tone hides a high-privilege admin grant - the gate must still send it for approval.

subject: VPN dropping AGAIN
body: This is the THIRD time this week the VPN has dropped on me in the middle of a client call. I am losing clients here. This needs to be fixed properly, not another restart.
note: Emotionally charged - tests that tone/urgency doesn't shift the category away from vpn_network.

subject: Office open on the holiday?
body: Is the office open on the public holiday next Thursday, or are we all working remotely that day? Wasn't sure who to ask.
note: Not an IT request at all - misdirected to the helpdesk. Should land as other.

subject: Sent salary sheet to wrong list
body: I've just realised I emailed the staff salary spreadsheet to the wrong distribution list by mistake. What do I do?? Can it be recalled? Please help, this is urgent.
note: Data exposure incident - high-stakes, urgent, must route to a human even though the user is asking 'how do I recall'.
